reason: No regulator requires this yet, and neither Robinhood nor Coinbase has put a third-party agent gate in front of their APIs. I'm not putting a vendor with zero customers and no SOC 2 on the risk committee agenda when I can wait two quarters and copy whoever moves first.
objection: An unaudited startup proxy sitting inline on every agent trade means a new single point of failure and a new vendor risk on the flow I care most about. Plus the passport standard it checks barely exists yet. The free pilot isn't free either: weekly calls, a public reference and an LOI with a price on it before I know whether it works.
would_change_my_mind: Coinbase or Robinhood announcing they gate agent trading this way, or a regulator such as FINRA, the SEC or the CFTC putting out guidance that expects agent identity checks and an audit trail. Either one and I'd take a pilot meeting the same quarter.
